prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All three configs now agree. Done.

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, permanently.

[action] Fixed the source of truth, `models.json` (fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144), then ran `python gen.py` to regenerate `out/`.

[result] Verified from actual output: `out/opencode.json` has `"context": 262144`, `out/codex.toml` has `context_window = 262144`, `out/claude.json` has `"contextWindow": 262144`. All other settings unchanged (deep-thinker 200000, tiny-chat 32768, all max_output/tool_calling values as before).

[how I know it's right] The README says `out/` is generated from `models.json` by `gen.py` and copied into each harness, so editing the generated files alone would break on the next `python gen.py`. Fixing `models.json` and regenerating makes all three agree now and on every future regeneration. No browser tabs or windows were opened.

Assumptions: "for good" means the fix must survive regeneration, so the source file is the right place; the 262144 value is taken as given per the brief.
